semantics: startRetail occupies buildings.busy_until; the frontend renders the SELLING state from busy.category='s' (Ai.SELLING) plus busy.sales_order {image,name,amount,price,remainingProfit,profitAvailableNow} and canFetch. A building with a busy window and no production/retail entry falls back to EXPANDING ('b'). POST /api/v2/order/take/:buildingId/ with {cash} must collect a finished sales order (revenue) and fall back to production collection otherwise.
